description: Verify Wave0 produced shared foundation evidence: _INDEX.md and README.md exist, 00-shared-*.md reference files exist (count_floor >=1), per-topic thin YAML exists in artifacts/wave0/ and passes ReferenceMetadata schema validation, and trace evidence is present. Source-gate status-window and handoff witness are enforced by shared gate preflight.

rules.failure_message: Wave0 completion requires a schema-valid globally quiescent queue with no active, refill, or delegated in-flight demand.

Missing file: reference/_INDEX.md. Write a canonical Markdown table inventory of all reference files with columns: ref_file, source_type, trust_level, tier, related_topic, source_layer, acceptance_status, date_landed.
Missing file: reference/README.md. Write a brief human-readable overview of the flat reference directory convention.
Missing directory: reference/. Create the directory and populate with 00-shared-*.md reference files.

Fewer than 1 submitted 00-shared-*.md reference output. Use the existing wave0_source_intake delegated work unit to research and fetch a real source, declare reference/00-shared-<slug>.md with role reference and source_url in output_files[], then dry-submit and formally submit it. Do not create an unsubmitted file directly under reference/.

repair.write_to: wave0_source_intake delegated work-unit output_files[] with role reference and source_url; then operate-work-unit dry-submit and submit

rules.failure_message: A 00-shared-*.md file contains placeholder source_url (example.com). Delete the placeholder file and write a real reference or suppl-failure-r{N}.md instead.
Missing per-topic thin YAML: artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml. Search and collect at least foundation floor count of references for each topic in the topic_registry.
Reference metadata in artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml fails schema validation. Each entry must have url, title, retrieved_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and topic_tag.
Topic {topic} has fewer than 1 reference metadata entries in artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml. Collect at least the foundation floor count for each topic.
No wave0_completion trace event found in rb_trace.jsonl. The phase must write a completion trace event before the gate.

Cache trail coverage gap detected: role=reference output files must map to verified _cache/ leaf directories. Missing or unmapped cache trails fail coverage; empty cache_trails on a declaration emits a Phase 1 warning.
No wave0 submitted work-unit ledger rows found. Claim and submit wave0_source_intake work units to populate rb_output_declarations.jsonl.
Wave0 outputs exist on disk but are not covered by submitted work-unit ledger rows. Submit delegated outputs through operate-work-unit.
Wave0 submitted work-unit rows failed index/manifest/result/receipt/beacon/output/cache/hash cross-checks.
Wave0 delegated artifacts appear without submitted work-unit coverage.
